hypothesis: Area- and finish-aware ability scoring will reduce mean completion round on matched development cases won by both versions without lowering matched win rate; unchanged/increased rounds or a win-rate regression falsifies the hypothesis.
mechanism: Score visible same-category area victims rather than only the aim target; cap overkill, reward finishes, use target-specific champion health-loss predictions. Compare resets against the same finish-value scale.
evidence_limit: No turn trace establishes wasted casts. Current edit base has 48/48 development wins; faster objective throughput is a rules/source deduction. Frozen opponent sources need not be versions in continuous self-play.
risk: Higher bounded scoring cost; splash wakes groups; altered casts may affect routing and kills. Basic/reset damage against champions is estimated, unlike spell prediction.
rejected_alternatives: Global capture-first routing has prior negative evidence; do not repeat without traces.
Fixed draft/Strength and 40-gem batching have negative evidence; retain incumbent.
Vendetta resets cooldowns, not the one-cast allowance; do not assume repeated same-turn casts.
Spawn-heal fixes were already tried separately; no new recovery evidence justifies repeating.
regressions: Eight compile-time scenario assertions in combat_scoring.h are included in the actual bot translation unit.

validation.report_inspection: Local report and approved check-report agree. Only summary diagnostics exposed; full-game completion, ability branch coverage and fuel headroom not established.
